title: Impera
studio_context: From January 2021 at Capitol (Hollywood), Atlantis Metronome and Apmamman (Stockholm); mixed by Andy Wallace.

drum_performances.name: The Nameless Ghoul on drums
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Kaisarion at 186 with the crash and snare on 1 and 3 and the kick on every off-beat; Spillways' ride with the hat foot in eighths; Call Me Little Sunshine's snare pickups. The studio drums are credited to a session player, not to the ghoul (the credit's name is not stored: the drummer's chair is private); the record stands for the parts the drumming ghoul plays live.

drums.description: A fast gallop: crash and snare on 1 and 3, the kick on every off-beat eighth; stabs in 3+3+2.
